name: orientdb
description: orientdb — OrientDB multi-model database CLI. Graph/document database console for queries and administration.

install_steps: curl -LO https://s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/orientdb3/releases/3.2.36/orientdb-3.2.36.tar.gz && tar xzf orientdb-3.2.36.tar.gz && sudo mv orientdb-3.2.36/bin/console.sh /usr/local/bin/orientdb-console && rm -rf orientdb-3.2.36*
install_guidance.note: Binary from GitHub releases or package manager.
